create issue (WORKING RECIPE, confirmed 2026-09-30 again): Write tool -> eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md (inside repo working dir only, NOT /tmp/gh-aw/*). Then `jq -Rs '{title: "literal text", body: ., labels: ["eslint","eslint-factory"]}' eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md > eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. Then `safeoutputs create_issue . < eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. Then rm both temp files, confirm `git status --short eslint-factory/` is clean.

dedupe: gh api query-string form WORKS: `gh api "repos/github/gh-aw/issues?state=open&per_page=100&labels=eslint-factory" --jq '.[] | {number,title}'`. The -f flag form 403s. Newly-filed issues via safeoutputs do NOT appear in this query during the same run (writes apply post-workflow). To check a specific issue's actual close reason/timing use `gh api repos/github/gh-aw/issues/<n> --jq '{state,state_reason,closed_at,created_at}'` - this DOES reflect already-applied history even for issues this workflow itself filed in a prior run.
